welcome.title: You wake on the grass
welcome.text: Move with W A S D, look with the mouse. Everything on this island is all there will ever be - look around before you take anything.

item_stone.title: A good stone
item_stone.text: Place a stone on the flat rock and strike it with a second stone to knap a sharp edge. (E on the flat rock while holding a stone.)

item_twig.title: Twigs
item_twig.text: Dry twigs catch fire easily. Gather a handful before you try to light anything.

item_clay.title: Clay!
item_clay.text: Raw clay is gritty. Work it on a flat surface with a little water before shaping it into pottery.

item_fiber.title: Plant fibre
item_fiber.text: Two bundles of fibre twist into cordage - on a flat surface, press E while holding fibre.

item_stone_head.title: A shaped head
item_stone_head.text: Bind it to a stick with cordage on a flat surface to make a real tool.

item_blade.title: A cutting edge
item_blade.text: Your blade cuts grass and fibre plants, and small branches from the tree. Hold the left mouse button on them.

item_grass.title: Cut grass
item_grass.text: Fresh grass is compost - or leave it out in the sun and it cures into straw: tinder, thatch and bedding.

item_branch.title: A leafy branch
item_branch.text: Put it down and cut it up with your blade: sticks, twigs and leaves.

item_earth.title: Earth
item_earth.text: Dug earth can be packed back into a hole, pressed over a woodpile to make a charcoal mound, or daubed onto wattle walls.

item_pot.title: Your pottery
item_pot.text: Wet clay must dry completely before firing or it will crack. Leave it somewhere dry - out of the rain.

item_seed_grain.title: Seeds
item_seed_grain.text: Till soil with a digging tool, then plant seeds and keep them watered.

item_tuber.title: Skyroot tuber
item_tuber.text: Edible raw, better roasted near a fire. Planted whole, one tuber grows several more.

item_food_scraps.title: Food scraps
item_food_scraps.text: What you eat returns to the island as scraps. Compost them to put the nutrients back into the soil.

clay_found.title: You've reached clay
clay_found.text: Under the topsoil near the pond lies clay. It's finite - dig thoughtfully.

water_first.title: Fresh water
water_first.text: Cupped hands only carry a mouthful. A fired clay vessel lets you carry water to crops - and to yourself.

drying.title: Drying
drying.text: Wet pottery dries over a few hours in warm, dry air. Rain will undo it - shelter it.

tilled.title: Tilled soil
tilled.text: Plant seeds or a tuber here (right mouse while holding them). Water and compost keep the soil productive.

watering.title: Watering
watering.text: Water soaks into the soil around where you pour. Too much simply runs off to the pond.

branch_cut.title: The tree regrows
branch_cut.text: Cut branches regrow over a day or two - from sunlight, water and nutrients. Fell the trunk and you'll wait days for a sapling.

tree_planted.title: A future tree
tree_planted.text: Tree seeds grow slowly. Water them in dry weather.

first_fire.title: Fire
first_fire.text: Fire needs fuel, heat and air. Small dry fuel first, then bigger pieces. Too little air and it smoulders.

charcoal_open.title: Opened too soon?
charcoal_open.text: If the mound is opened while hot, air rushes in and the charcoal burns away to ash.

cold.title: You're getting cold
cold.text: Nights are cold up here. A fire, walls and a roof all help - and staying dry.
